description_sq:
APARTAMENT 2+1 NE SHITJE MYSLYM SHYRI
Ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes ofrojme per shitje nje apartament 2+1 me garderobe , me nje siperfaqe neto 89.2 m2 .
I pozicionuar ne katin e dyte te nje pallati te viteve 2000 me ashensor.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor, eshte ne proces ndarje nga 3+1 si dhe projektimi i paguar.
Ndricim i bollshem natyral si dhe akses i menjehershem nga rruga kryesore.
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE MYSLYM SHYRI In one of the most sought after areas of Tirana we offer for sale a 2+1 apartment with a wardrobe, with a net area of ​​89.2 m2. Located on the second floor of a building from the 2000s with an elevator. The property has regular mortgage documentation, it is in the process of dividing from 3+1 and the design has been paid. Abundant natural lighting as well as immediate access from the main road.
